turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
hile a damaged item may qualify as a manufacturing-defect or delivery-damage claim. Defective products can qualify for a return label or reimbursement of return shipping, but the issue must be reviewed with clear photos and details about the damage. Manufacturing defects are covered for one year from delivery; normal wear and tear is not. A refund is issued after the return is received and processed, and the card credit can take up to 10 business days after the processing notification.

I’m sorry you’re dealing with a damaged item. Yes, it is handled differently from a normal change-of-mind return: a normal return is generally within 14 days, with return shipping paid by the customer, while a damaged item may qualify as a manufacturing-defect or delivery-damage claim. Defective products can qualify for a return label or reimbursement of return shipping, but the issue must be reviewed with clear photos and details about the damage. Manufacturing defects are covered for one year from delivery; normal wear and tear is not. A refund is issued after the return is received and processed, and the card credit can take up to 10 business days after the processing notification.
